storage.built_in: 12, 16, 20 or 24 TB of storage drives by model, plus an SSD system drive

features: Records H.264, MJPEG and MPEG-4 IP streams
Up to 64 analog cameras through optional ENC5516 direct-attach encoder, within the 128 combined stream limit
3 x USB 2.0 (1 front, 2 rear) and 2 x USB 3.0 (rear)
dimensions_mm: 508 x 434 x 89 (D x W x H)
notes: Maximum operating power ranges from 204.1 W to 224.0 W depending on mains voltage and frequency; the sheet gives no HDD condition.
Unit weight varies by drive configuration, from 13.6 kg (DSSRV2-120RD) to 16.3 kg (DSSRV2-240RD); no single weight is given.
Total throughput is 350 Mbps with RAID and 300 Mbps with JBOD.
The cited spec sheet is the Italian edition (C4014IT).
